prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone full-body transparent PNG game reaction sprite. AUTHORITATIVE PROPORTION AND RENDERING reference is image 1 (sexy.png): adult cartoon CHIBI, about 3.2 HEADS TALL, oversized rounded head occupying roughly one THIRD of total standing height, compact torso, short stylized limbs, tiny hands and shoes. Match that reference's dark brown thick rounded linework, flat warm fills, sparse soft shading, simple dot eyes and peach blush. Absolutely do NOT use tall 5-to-7-head teenage or realistic anatomy. Image 2 provides the childhood character's recognizable hairstyle and colors, to interpret as an ADULT now. Whole body including hands and shoes inside canvas with generous padding. TRUE transparent alpha background with clean cutout edges. No glow, halo, bloom, ambient haze, background, floor or cast shadow. No words, logos, watermark or other people. The same male character now a young ADULT MAN: recognizable tousled brown short hair, warm friendly adult face, large rounded head like the proportion reference, no beard. Blue open casual jacket over a plain ivory shirt, brown full-length trousers, simple blue casual shoes with cream soles. Compact mature cartoon silhouette, not a lanky adolescent. Keep this outfit unchanged across all poses. Neutral standing model-sheet pose, both eyes open, relaxed friendly smile, arms down beside body, feet on ground, front three-quarter view. No props.
